constraints.text: City base is Tokyo only. No Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, or Ghibli Park.
Ski Nozawa ~5 proper days plus an arrival afternoon.
Tokyo: one MIMARU building, 3 two-beds (or a connecting 8 + one 2-bed) — not 3 Airbnbs.

lodging.tokyoNote: Default Tokyo lodging is the first 3 nights (27–30 Dec). Station East member FROM ¥345,519 / apt for those nights. Last 4 nights are city travel and may not be Tokyo — not in the pp numbers. Live vacant Station East A:26 / B:13. Hatchobori and Suites Nihombashi are backups.

options.note: 3 nights (27–30 Dec). 2 apts × Station East member FROM ¥345,519 ÷ 8 = ¥86,380. Connecting-8 is 2 bedrooms / 8 singles in one lockup if they want one key. Last 4 nights are city travel / unbooked — not in this total.

lines.title: Tokyo accommodation
lines.note: MIMARU Station East, 3 nights (27–30 Dec). 8 people / 2 apts, ¥86,380 pp. Member FROM ¥345,519 / apt. 10p / 3 apts ~$650; 12p / 3 apts ~$545. Last 4 nights are city travel / unbooked — not in this total.

lines.title: Nozawa accommodation
lines.note: Kashmir House, 6 nights (30 Dec 2026–5 Jan 2027). 8 people, ~¥137,763 pp / ¥1,102,100 total.

lines.title: Tickets (snow monkeys)
lines.note: Default: Kotsu half-day tour, adult ¥9,000 (includes bus + ¥800 admission). Park gate only ~$5 (¥800) per person. Optional child tour ~$31 (¥5,000). Jigokudani only. Book from 1 Oct 2026. FX 1 USD = 158.96 JPY, Xe mid-market 23 Aug 2026.

yamato.text: Yamato Ski TA-Q-BIN from a hotel desk is typically about ¥2,500–4,000 per piece. Convenience-store drop-off is not available for Ski TA-Q-BIN. Ship so the bag is at the resort the day before you ski.

train.text: Hakutaka only. Kagayaki skips Iiyama. Tokyo or Ueno → Iiyama about 1h40, about ¥8,300–8,900. No Japan Rail Pass for this itinerary (Tokyo–Iiyama return does not earn one). Book JR-EAST Train Reservation, not SmartEX.

transfer.text: Jumbo taxi about ¥12,500 for up to 9, or Stay Nozawa van ¥13,000 for up to 8. Do not plan a van on 29–31 Dec or 2–4 Jan. Liner bus adult ¥600 if the private options are gone.

tickets.season: 2026–27 regular season (19 Dec 2026–28 Mar 2027 on the official table)

onsen.sotoYu: 13 free village soto-yu, run by Yunakama neighbourhoods. Bring your own towel and soap.

snowMonkeys.price: Adult ~$57 (¥9,000; tour includes bus + park admission)
